name: CloberDEX
summary: Rebalancer invoked an untrusted strategy burnHook before reducing its recorded pool reserves. A callback could reenter burn while the stale reserves remained available, causing the same WETH liquidity to be counted and withdrawn twice.
notes: Direct immutable Rebalancer runtime deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit; its pre-exploit and current runtime hashes match, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, SELFDESTRUCT, or CREATE2 instruction.

Exact pre-recovery victim depletion is 133.7 WETH: Rebalancer's WETH balance fell from 133.707875556674808577 immediately before the anchor transaction to 0.007875556674808577 afterward. The receipt records 267.4 WETH supplied to Rebalancer from flash-loan proceeds, 401.1 WETH returned across the nested burns, repayment of the 267.4 WETH principal, and retention of the 133.7 WETH victim depletion. Published analysis values 133.7 WETH at approximately $501,279; the USD total is therefore reported rather than independently price-reproduced.

The 133.7 WETH victim depletion is exact, but the approximately $501,279 USD total is retained from published incident-time reporting rather than an independently reproduced historical price observation.
